# Verdict CLI — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Deterministic, evidence-bound trust scoring for AI agents — the CWI Verdict Engine v1.0.0 as runnable software. Returns a scored verdict with a full evidence trace, or an honest refusal. Never invents a score. Stdlib-only Python, $0, no network, no accounts.

## Machine facts
- registry_slug: cwi-verdict-cli
- type: app (app = standalone product site; gear = licensable Agent Deck SKU)
- live_url: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-cli/
- data_truth: LIVE  (LIVE = live-verified facts · SAMPLE = sample/seed data, never presented as verified · MIXED = labeled per-section)
- status: live
- category: pending
- tags: pending
- agent_card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-cli/.well-known/agent-card.json
- metadata_status: complete
- repo: CumulativeWebInc/cwi-verdict-cli
- per_product_llms: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/registry/cwi-verdict-cli/llms.txt

## Capabilities
- evidence-bound trust scoring
- evidence-admission gating
- Sybil damping
- honest refusals (insufficient-data / evidence-disputed / unknown-context / invalid-input)
- machine-readable reports (report.json) with input_sha256
- CLI pipeline integration (check command, exit codes)

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-cli/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
